scope: Fresh complete actual-file mathematical audit of both candidate units.
checks: Connected etale resolution covers have one smooth exceptional curve and genus/normal degree scaled by t, including p-divisible t.
Slope windows, poles and positive-layer H1 give fixed ordinary depth independently of t, r, f.
One initial determinant character; at most r+1 exceptional line extensions per phase; no moving-Pic degree inflation.
Actual all-coefficient-ring fixed-line bundle/map construction gives O(f t r^2) coordinates with constant equation degree; fixed reference cochains contribute constants.
Finite unit-Isom openness and ordinary component bounds give the hereditary linear-index count.
Explicit nonabelian Shapiro formula and A-conjugacy are correctly oriented and continuous.
Distinct crown coordinates yield distinct lift classes; normalizer multiplicity and LMT estimates give the stated uniform generator bound.
Only pure-permutation action, unramified permutation quotient, and faithful linear-size simple groups are included.
